review.algorithm_assessment: Normal-play Nim is losing exactly when all pile sizes XOR to0. Walsh-Hadamard transform diagonalizes XOR convolution; independent identically distributed piles raise each transformed coefficient to powern. The zero component is their mean, so subtract from1. Pad to next power of2 and only clamp tiny floating-point endpoint error.
review.limitations: One source reviewer plus actual isolated tests, not independent dual semantic review.
